name: WordPress Trac
description: Provides access to WordPress.org Trac development data through public CSV and RSS endpoints, enabling searches across 60,000+ tickets, detailed ticket retrieval with metadata and comments, changeset information with diff content, and recent development activity monitoring for WordPress core contributors and plugin developers.

tools.name: searchTickets
tools.description: Search for WordPress Trac tickets by keyword or filter expression. Returns ticket summaries with basic info.

query.description: Search query for tickets (keywords or filter expressions like 'summary~=keyword')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

component.description: Filter by component name (e.g., 'Administration', 'Posts, Post Types')

tools.name: getTicket
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific WordPress Trac ticket including description, comments, and metadata.

includeComments.description: Include ticket comments and discussion (default: true)

commentLimit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: getChangeset
tools.description: Get information about a specific WordPress code changeset/commit including commit message, author, and diff.

diffLimit.description: Maximum characters of diff to return (default: 2000, max: 10000)

tools.name: getTimeline
tools.description: Get recent activity from WordPress Trac timeline including recent tickets, commits, and other events.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 7, max: 30)

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: getTracInfo
tools.description: Get WordPress Trac metadata like components, milestones, priorities, and severities.

type.description: Type of Trac information to retrieve
